gloss: means of transportation; way of getting around

definitions.gloss: means of transportation; mode of getting around
definitions.explanation: The method or vehicle a person uses to travel from one place to another — a car, train, bicycle, walking, and so on. A practical everyday term for how one moves about.

examples.japanese: {移動手段|いどうしゅだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧です。
examples.english: My means of transportation is the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{移動手段|いどうしゅだん}だ。
examples.english: In the countryside, the car is the main means of transportation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{移動手段|いどうしゅだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: When planning a trip, it is convenient to decide on your means of transportation first.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧ (movement, travel) + ⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧ (means, method). Refers to whatever a person uses to get around.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {移動手段|いどうしゅだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to secure a means of transportation
- ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{移動手段|いどうしゅだん}: the main mode of transport
- {移動手段|いどうしゅだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no way of getting around

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交通手段|こうつうしゅだん}: means of transportation — nearly synonymous, but leans slightly toward public transport systems.
- ⟦{乗|の}り{物|もの}→乗り物：01694_norimono⟧: vehicle; ride — the physical vehicle itself, not the method of travel.
